name: talk
description: Talk: the voice memo. The compact transport recorder (ready), the kept recording with its row and the way back (kept, transcribing), and three microphone drawings kept for the comp (before, denied, missing). One render for every platform; for the kept recording desktop puts the back link in the title block beside the page.

platform.description: The device the page is drawn for. Desktop's rule for the kept recording: the back link is the title block (mast form title) beside the page (shell layout sidebar), and the page is headed untitled. Mobile and tablet: the masthead row, with the back link, inside the page. The recorder section is the same on every platform. The kept recording's waveform is the wave's own (v4 round 10).

noRule.desktop: a page has no CSS: the platform chooses which modules it composes and how

state.description: The page's states, named as the prototype's routes (journal-website.html): ready (talk: the compact recorder), kept (recording-kept), transcribing. The microphone states (microphone-before, -denied, -missing and the flow pack's flow-mic-permission, -denied, -missing) are reference drawings only (DESIGN.md 2026-10-14): the website redirects them to the live recorder, so they are kept as states for the comps and are not routes of the product. paused is the recorder paused (16-flow-states, s-recording-paused); kept-notice is a generic state page (system/content/state-page.mjs, s-recording-kept).

changelog.change: Pages round 4b: the flow pack's states (16-flow-states): flow-mic-permission, flow-mic-denied, flow-mic-missing (reference drawings), paused, and kept-notice (a generic state page).
Pages round 2: 03-talk (ready, kept, transcribing and the three microphone reference states) on the three platforms, at parity with the screens.
Variant context (screen, walkthrough): the walkthroughs render the page directly (pages round 5).
RecommendedChanges-v4 B6: state recording (16-flow-states s-recording); the recorder's trace and the kept row draw the memo's fixed shape.
v4 C5: paused passes the memo's length (the player, Discard); states paused-draft (#s-recording-draft) and discard-confirm (#s-recording-discard), 16-flow-states.
v4 round 10: a recording's waveform is the wave's own (the memo's phrase at a fixed pitch); waves.mjs retired.
